description:
Check ONE field on a core model: which majors CAN have it, its type, whether it was
    removed or newly added, and (for 19 and 20) its computed/relational dependencies. Best guardrail
    against referencing a field a version REMOVED (e.g. sale.order.line.product_uom, gone in 19).
    Pass version=0 to see all majors. READ-ONLY.

    CAVEAT: `exists:true` / `present_in` means the field is defined SOMEWHERE in the Community +
    Enterprise + localization UNION for those majors - NOT that it's in a given install (an
    Enterprise or localization field returns exists:true even on Community). To confirm a field is
    really in a SPECIFIC database, use odoo_db_model_fields. The removed_in direction IS reliable.
    Returns present_in, type, removed_in / added_in, and depends (compute/related/comodel on 19/20).
name: odoo_field_check
